The game goes from Zenless Zone Zero to Gooner Zone Max (and it's going on...)

ZZZ lost his initial charm, changed the direction more than once, and discontinued to be rather worried about it.

I played ZZZ a lot before coming to Steam; I played from the Initial Release in 2024, and played to this very day of this review (when I finaly uninstalled) I have at least 2000-3000 hours in-game prior to the Steam Release.

and the reason for this Review is rather stricly subjective, coming entirely from my own personal view, perspective and observation.

1. Optimization/Performance
The game has never been good with the optimization, ironically enough it was somehow best shortly after the launch for some time, then the game has degraded slowly but surely, making a lot if not most of areas CPU extensive to the point that most of the CPU's even if they would, then they wouldn't keep up... 

and then update after update the game is running worse and worse taking some of the enjoyment straight out the window. 

2. Gooner Aspect
The game strictly made their main target set on Gooners/Creeps fanbase and they continue to add even more elements tied to fanservice with it being  done without much shame or a reason... 

most (if not all) newer released Agents lack of character, all they have is a body aspects, that doesn't hold any resemblance of their role nor position in the game world... 

and the skins are started to be just... inappropiate to say about the least of them... swimsuits, latex suits, or just exposed body parts for the gooner audience to cater

3. Power Creep
It's not a suprise that most of the newer characters are insanely good and much better than the older units, making them required more than preferred to do some if not most of the End-Game Content. The game is playable enough with some skill and investment, but you will suffer if you don't have latest units with their supports (some older are viable sometimes, but the newer are king...)

The game is not viable to play in some places due to this nature and state, the new players would have it difficult or close to impossible to even try to catchup, and current/veteran players would have it difficult to get most of the new units with their signature weapons, making it, ehh... 

It's not that bad of a thing, cause the game should earn some money... but making it to the point that you're just ruled out of some content rather than being like "Okay, I will continue to play and will push up through the difficulty and rank with time!" well... no you wouldn't... the characters are coming faster than you will be able to, so all there is to do is some Story (mediocre hit or miss ♥♥♥♥) some Limited Time Events (if you would be able to access them) and Voiceless Side Stories (a lot of content is just text) 

4.Content/Story

The story plummeted hard into the oblivion with newer installments, and it's nowhere as engaging and meaningful as it was back in the day.
I was finding myself thinking why I'm still playing this game, and the answer was "Story" / "Game World" / "Character Interaction"

but much of that changed later into the game... the Story is just so reimagined from what it should be based on original game vision, that the Game World feel abandoned by the Developers (For the most parts, especially comparing the new to the old; the older areas are much better but are abandonded) and the newer Areas are just... One Time Deal... somehow... with it changing theme so drastically that you might found yourself clueless... 

and the Character Interaction? ohh boi... forget the Story that we had in 1.0, the new ones are just... gradually different, and subjectively worse... 

There's like no passion, and no soul to the game anymore.

5. Summary 

I didn't leave the game on a whim, I hoped that the game would turn to the better with time or to what it was/supposed to be, but it didn't... they catered to Gooners Audience more... released the game on Steam cause the player retention was bad/worse... and then they want the game to live this empty life. (See how they use some Graphics from 1.0 Story Content/Characters CAUSE THEY WERE ACTUALY GOOD, THE CORE OF THE GAME) rather than using anything new (it's deteroriated pretty bad)

and finally I leave the game with nothing to keep me there, the game drifted soo much from how and what it was back in the day, and didn't go into the initial direction of it, the game changed, so the playerbase has to change too (to some extent) and that will be me... 

DISCLAIMER: I have nothing against gooning nor fanservice, this game done this rather good back in the day, but with the newer installments it's just grossly weirding me out... it's like the main DNA of the game lately, and I didn't signed up on that, I stayed for some updates, and the latest 3.0 - 3.1 was it for me... the end of the Journey that started in New Eridu.

and I'm not against the changes, I just didn't find anything in there for me anymore, played the game when it was good/meaningful for me, stayed when it wasn't like this anymore, then left when it was different, weird, inappropriate and rather uneventful for me at the time. 

I could say a lot more about this game, but that would be mostly even more oddly specific and hardly subjective perspective about the game, developer, community and shenanigans of this game.

I would still give this game a go and a chance if I would be starting from scratch, but well... probably not for long with the current state of "Everything" Core there is to the game (especially much lately) but who knows, maybe you woud like it...

I haven't touched a MiHoyo game since Genshin Impact came out and abandoned it about 2-3 months in, and that left a bad taste for me to this day. Granted the game's probably better now, but I believe this bias is important to bring up. So, what about Zenless Zone Zero?

First of all, the core action gameplay is quite fun, pretty good even. I've heard people say it plays like Devil May Cry, but I can't say that since I've never played any of them. You get three characters (plus a supporting little friend called Bangboos for an extra attack) in your squad when starting a level/area and they each play off one another. A character can either be (at this point of the review): Attack, Defense, Anomaly (basically stat-inducing characters), Stun, Support, and Rupture (I honestly have no idea what they are still, I don't even have a decent character with that type). And then there's the attributes... well there's a bunch but simply put all these traits and types help shape your squads. Combo this, change character here, parry/dodge there; eventually you'll find a flow of sorts. Your characters do not have gear other that a thing called W-Engines which kind of acts like the all-in-one gear plus discs that can add or improve existing stats.

Then there's the other game modes. Some utilize the action gameplay while others are simply minigames that take place in specific zones or the world hubs. I don't really like the investigation/exploration modes that can be found in Season 1, so I'm glad the game has these tickets to skip them (of course they're either gited to you or you have to buy them with whatever in-game currency). Most of the minigames are fine, you'll probably blitz through them in an hour or less. Doing any of these will give you freebies like materials and premium currency.

So the gameplay is decent, but what about the story and characters? The main story so far has not left a strong impression to me, and I would blame the boring main characters. You play as the Phaeton siblings Akira and Rin (Wise and Belle) that, in my opinion, barely go through any sort of development right until this 3rd season. It's the usual shtick where you learn of big bad then fight another big bad to find even more big bad while uncovering the past events. Despite this, it's not that bad whenever they introduce characters each chapter 'cause at the very least they're interesting to follow. As for relationships, you'll never get past being best friends with any of them.

For the miscellaneous stuff: Game runs OK on decent computers though it could be better. What do you mean I need DLSS or DLAA to get 60 fps in the hub world? The UI is serviceable, but I would like a feature to resize the scale so the action buttons don't look so big. Like any modern free-to-play game, there are dailies that you can do to top up your stamina and farm materials.

Now the elephant in the room: what about the gacha and other paid items? It's quite bad. There's no absolute guarantees for the pity counter. That means if you want Character A from the ongoing banner and you reach the pity S-rank count, you'll instead get a chance for Character A [b]OR[/b] 6 S-rank characters that you can choose from the new tuning update. I don't need to explain how bad that is. It's 2026 and literally every gacha game I'm playing to this day has a proper guarantee for a character you want (some games that I play include Stella Sora, Mongil Star Dive, Gakuen Idolmaster). This also applies to the W-Engines, so you will need a lot of luck or money to eventually gamble to getting them. There are skins that you can buy... and honestly, there's nothing to really add. There's also the usual monthly membership and packages that we are all used to seeing.

[b]TL;DR[/b] Fun game but meh story carried by interesting characters and terrible gacha system even with the new update. This is one of those games where I wish Steam had a neutral rating, but it's still a fun game so it's still a thumbs up.

Im recommending this game purely for its gameplay, mechanics, and the unique playstyles of its characters. If it were not for those things, I probably wouldn't recommend it at all.

I genuinely love this game because of how good the gameplay feels. I wish we had a Final Fantasy Dissidia game with combat like this, bro. It would be CINEMA. Honestly, put these mechanics into almost any franchise and it would be a banger. The combat is so satisfying that I could sit here talking about it for hours.

But the one thing that always pushes me away from ZZZ is seeing female character after female character every single patch.

I grew up playing Final Fantasy and tons of other games where we had so many badass male and female characters. I just wish ZZZ had a more balanced ratio.

The game being a gacha isn't even my biggest issue with it. My biggest problem is how heavily the roster is focused on female characters, and a lot of them start feeling repetitive to me: similar personalities, similar body types, and the same kind of sexualized designs over and over again.

Sexualization obviously isn't something exclusive to ZZZ. The entire gacha space is known for the whole "waifu" obsession, and some games even sexualize characters who are minors, which I find disgusting.

But even putting that aside, I wouldn't mind ZZZ having a female-heavy roster nearly as much if the male characters actually received the same treatment. And when they do a lot of them are lower-tier characters, and even the new S-rank Billy doesn't feel as strong as some of the top characters. Then, when they finally reveal a male character with a really cool design, they make him an A-rank agent, like Manato.

I just wish the developers would give us more badass male characters, more variety, and a more balanced roster.

As for the gacha itself, the game is actually pretty generous, I'd even say more generous than Dragalia Lost and Granblue Fantasy, which are the gachas I've played the most.

You really don't need to spend a penny to experience the game, its story, or most of its game modes.

So yeah, I recommend ZZZ because the gameplay is genuinely fantastic. The combat and character mechanics are easily the reason I keep coming back.

I just wish the character roster had the same level of variety as the gameplay.

只說好玩的部分，遊戲性彈刀手感是真好，合軸淺顯易懂，操作沒那麼複雜，想深入手法就是去找別人影片學，但前提是命座跟專武，養成部分還是要有一定的取得量，會更好循環這些操作。

開始抽角色之後，跟鳴潮一樣，就特愛別搞小保底機制，50%，1/2機率，還是給我歪，跟別人一樣，不是快小保底出，就是大保底，1/10，10連抽的機率，還可以抽不到，不知道是讀心還是怎樣，當無課玩家資源很好攢就對了? 我都懷疑是不是某些特定數字ID就自帶歐皇? 再不然就是特別非洲運氣? 　別跟我說什麼平常心去抽就好，啥屁都不是，每次新手運就那麼的一次，後面就把爛運氣加成回來，硬要把接近保底的抽成運氣帶回來。　

反觀其他人10連抽裡面3抽就帶角色回家，專武10連，還可以帶3把回家，有沒有搞錯？　都懷疑有差別待遇

養成：光是在我新手時期找了老半天，都還沒看懂，還得要去看專人影片解說才能大概明白用途跟資源取得跟分配，有人可能會想說我是不是跳過教學，真不好意思，我只要是親手玩過的遊戲，新手教學都會很仔細的看過好幾次，我還為此拖了很久才開始認真拓荒，而不是急著無腦打，然後不知道遊戲的本意是做什麼，但論解說我是沒那麼的完全理解，除非我自己主觀認定某些人的見解跟我差不多的意思。

為了防止不理解其中的運行原理，至少都會去實戰打怪再去熟悉鍵盤按鍵或是手把的功能，玩不玩得好就是其次的問題，當然我不會說我玩得特別極端操作，而去看不起別人玩太爛。　　但是有些人就是會去抱怨遊戲有些奇怪的點，拿手殘當藉口，尤其是一些很基本的操作，甚至忘記怎麼玩，明明就有暫停可以翻找教學，就是不去邊練習邊看介面。　

我本身也不是什麼強度黨，就介於XP之間做選擇，除非是為了打那種「危區絕境」的那種高難度副本，不然一般來說，只要拿好特定的階段資源就不會再奢求，但就是吐槽抽卡機制的小保跟大保，就是太賭爛，我只想抽著XP，有一定的強度就夠自己玩，小保底就歪了不喜歡的，浪費一堆加密母帶抽了一堆，啥屁都不是，連最基礎的平鋪都沒辦法組成，那還要我怎麼嘗試玩新隊伍？ 　總不能我每次都只玩御三家吧？

主線不評論好與壞，再怎麼樣都是著重養成，看太多PTSD的劇情遊戲太多，有拯救世界的歡樂結局，或是各種有說有笑就是讚，其他一概沒再管。

還有養成太卡上限等級，還有功能開放，劇情確實是太短，很多技能養成都卡「繩匠等級」上限，導致角色技能也不能升，就算你材料、丁尼再多，抱歉，你必須先提高「繩匠等級」，當然先屯一堆沒有錯，至少有提前備好，才不會短時間內，缺資源的問題，可偏偏又是劇情的怪，隨著推進，會逐漸提高硬度，如果「代理人」等級如果不及時跟上劇情怪物的扛度，那可能連劇情小怪都過不了，當然，只要稍微一點點的技術跟自身的反應，會看紅光閃招，黃光彈刀就夠了，也是可以磨過去，差就在自己耐心夠不夠而已，抽卡的保底機制就是最爛的部分，大部分其實都還不錯。　僅此自己作為部分休閒玩家的看法。

順帶一提：邦布作為遊戲吉祥物，也是很好的安排。
